question: Should `socket.drain` guarantee delivery by disconnecting/resyncing slow clients, or should teardown notifications remain subject to the existing lossy slow-client policy?
rationale: The PR’s `dropIfSlow: false` choice changes the Gateway’s delivery and availability contract; source tests cannot choose the intended operational tradeoff.

options.title: Use bounded recovery delivery
options.body: Disconnect or otherwise bound a slow subscriber, then require the client to reconnect and resync before continuing.

options.title: Keep existing lossy policy
options.body: Leave teardown events under the normal slow-client drop policy and document that clients must reconcile state after reconnect.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the new event until Gateway owners specify a resumable delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Use bounded recovery delivery
recommendation.body: Disconnect or otherwise bound a slow subscriber, then require the client to reconnect and resync before continuing.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a protocol and operational policy decision, and the available timeline connects this reviewer to the PR discussion.
